verdict.rationale: Paperspace ships an official CLI, `pspace`. It has a dedicated reference page ("Programmatically manage resources using the Paperspace Command Line Interface"), and a probe confirms that page exists. The docs also name the CLI as one way to create machines, and API keys authenticate the CLI (the older Gradient CLI) alongside the REST API and JS SDK. missing for 10: detailed command coverage and AI-native ergonomics (e.g., machine-readable output, non-interactive auth) beyond summary-level doc snippets, clarity on the old Gradient CLI vs. the new pspace CLI transition, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
